Developer: ORASCOM Project: GOUNA Unit Details: Type of Property: Chalet Number of Bedrooms: 1 Number Of Bathrooms: 1 For More Informations: (MH) El Gouna is a high-end, self-contained resort town located on Egypt's Red Sea coast. Developed by billionaire Samih Sawiris' Orascom Development in 1990, it is famous for its unique layout of 20 islands interconnected by beautiful, winding lagoons and stone bridges, earning it the nickname the "Venice of Egypt". The town is located 22 kilometers north of Hurghada and is roughly a 25-minute drive from Hurghada International Airport. Key Hubs & Districts: Abu Tig Marina: The town’s premier luxury marina, lined with superyachts, upscale global dining restaurants, chic boutiques, and lively bars. Downtown (Kafr El Gouna): The cultural center of the town, featuring traditional Nubian-style architecture, colorful local markets, affordable supermarkets, cafes, and open-air entertainment. Tamr Henna Square: A lively palm-shaded square inside Downtown packed with outdoor seating, restaurants, and retail shops. World-Class Amenities: Elite Accommodations: Features 18 premium hotels ranging from eco-conscious boutique stays to luxury resorts like The Chedi, Casa Cook, and Steigenberger. Championship Golf: Offers pristine 18-hole golf courses irrigated entirely by recycled water. El Gouna International Hospital: A cutting-edge healthcare facility featuring a 24-hour emergency room and the largest hyperbaric decompression chamber in the Middle East. Activities & Leisure: Water Sports: An international hotspot for kitesurfing, windsurfing, wakeboarding at Sliders Cable Park, and scuba diving along vibrant coral reefs. Popular Beaches: Frequented spots include Mangroovy Beach (the top kite-surfing beach) and Zeytuna Beach, situated on its own private island.
